name: SteamSpy
what_it_is: A statistics site that estimates owners and audience for Steam games from public Steam profile data, with lists by genre, tag, company and country.
pricing: No prices appear on the opened pages; the About page calls it a side project of its author.
key_features: Owner estimates with margin of error
notable: About page says the site is still in beta and often wrong by some margin

facts.fact: SteamSpy says it gathers data from Steam user profiles to present game statistics for indie developers, journalists, students and PC gaming fans.
The About page says owner numbers carry a stated margin of error at 98% confidence and that stats for games with small samples are very unreliable.
The About page says 'owned' does not mean 'sold' and that free weekends distort the owners figure.
The About page describes the site as a side project of Sergey Galyonkin with a copyright range of 2015-2021.

name: Niko Partners
what_it_is: A market research firm selling video game and esports data, reports, trackers and consulting for Asia and MENA.
platforms: Web knowledge base (NikoIQ), reports and data trackers
pricing: Not stated on the opened page; the page offers a NikoIQ demo and contact options.
notable: Homepage lists free bulletins and white papers
Homepage quotes Zynga, NCSOFT and Savvy Games Group executives

facts.fact: Niko Partners describes itself as delivering market data and insights for video games and esports in Asia and MENA.
The homepage lists NikoIQ, Data and Insights Trackers, Research Reports and Custom Consulting as its products and services.
The homepage offers a NikoIQ demo booking and shows no prices.
The homepage lists free research in the form of bulletins and white papers.
